title: Cairn with a local model
description: Cairn's board beside Claude Code, with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another one with Anthropic's Messages API): Cairn's workers are the session's Claude Code on that model, behind the relay's loop guard and with the model's real context window; only the server's address is opened, the provider's hosts stay closed.

de.title: Cairn mit einem lokalen Modell
de.description: Cairns Brett neben Claude Code, mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer mit Anthropics Messages-API): Cairns Worker sind das Claude Code der Sitzung mit diesem Modell, hinter dem Schleifenschutz des Relays und mit dem echten Kontextfenster des Modells; nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, die Hosts des Anbieters bleiben zu.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

origin.label: What is given: the project, the target, the scope (Cairn's origin; optional: make the project on the board)

goal.label: The goal: what counts as done (with the origin, the project is made at the start)

hint.label: A first hint for the workers (optional)

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent claude asks it for the API Claude Code uses (Ollama 0.14.0, LM Studio 0.4.1, llama.cpp b7187, vLLM 0.11.1 or later).

Cairn's workers are the session's Claude Code, run in the agent's container through sandbox-ai's relay: what --llm configures for the agent holds for every task Cairn gives it - the server, the model, the relay's parameters and the loop guard on the wire, the model's context window. OpenRouter is one such server too (sandbox-ai llm add openrouter -k openai-compatible -u https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 -s SECRET -m MODEL -a).

Cairn's tasks are long (bootstrap, reason, explore): a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). Only one worker runs at a time here.

Podman only. Build the images once: sandbox-ai build claude, sandbox-ai build cairn and sandbox-ai build browser (the board opens in the app's Browser button). With origin and goal the project is made at the start; else make it on the board.

Once a project is active, Cairn hands out tasks on its own until it is complete or stopped, and a failing task is handed out again; the relay pauses the workers after 5 failed tasks in a row. Stop the project on the board to stop it.
Licence: Cairn is AGPL-3.0, built unchanged from the reviewed commit by sandbox-ai build cairn on your machine; using it for yourself puts no duty on you.

Another harness on the same server is a worker too: the same options with that harness as the lead and the worker (sandbox-ai pi --llm NAME --no-provider-defaults --cairn --cairn-workers pi); sandbox-ai cairn workers shows how far each harness is supported, as a traffic light.
